description: Assign group name s to markers in the range. Use of the group logic is described in Groups .

keywords.name: remove
keywords.description: Remove group s from the marker. If no slot is specified the group assignment is removed from all slots it is found in.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Assign the group to the slot named s . The default slot is Default .

notes: Markers only exist once `massflow compute` has created them, so grouping by position before the material has moved there selects nothing: `range position-z 350 500` caught 0 of 1117 markers on a model at day 20.
